notes: two taḥwīl branches; the tail after the second «ح» is shared; «حدثنا أبي» (Ibn Numayr's father) and «عن أبيه» (Buraydah) are relation links; the text does not say that this father is the same man as عبد الله بن نمير of the first branch, so they are not merged (rule 9); «وهو ابن مغول» is a gloss left out
